name: dopamine-debt
description: Makes deadpan, meme-led comedy explainer films about your channel's subject, with the house style as guidance and an optional score you can run on the script and the cut.

cli.name: dd
cli.description: Dopamine Debt: `inso dd setup <brand>` (writes house-gates.json), `inso dd gate <script|cut> <production> <report>`, `inso dd new-film <production>`, `inso dd import <earlier kit> <brand>`, `inso dd root`
